options.text: How come you live with the lizardmen?

steps.player: How come you live with the lizardmen?

steps.npc: They are my sssaviours, I owe them my life.

steps.player: What did they save you from? Is it to do with your eye?

steps.npc: Why, yesss it isss... Many yearsss ago now. 30? 40? I've lost count.
I wasss a Captain of the Shayzien Army, Captain Reynard Koil, ssstationed up on Shayziens' wall.
We were told to attack the lizardmen, for they were apparently attacking usss. I led the charge.
Alasss, I took an arrow to the eye and missed the battle. I woke up here, worried for my life.
At first, that isss what I thought, but they tended my woundsss and fed me well.
I assssumed my people would come for me once they sssaw my body wasn't amongssst the dead, but they never did.

steps.player: Would the lizardmen let you leave?

steps.npc: Oh yesss, once my ssstrength returned, I went and ssspoke to the Shayzien Army.
They thought I wasss a lizardman and fired arrowsss at me, ssso I returned here.
I found these in thisss shrine. I guesss they belonged to sssome long dead priest.

steps.player: What would a priest be doing in this gross swamp?

steps.npc: This grossss ssswamp is my home. You sssure do ask a lot of questionsss, adventurer.

options.text: What is the symbol on the shrine?

steps.player: What is the symbol on the shrine?

steps.npc: You do not recognissse it, adventurer? It would ssseem hissstory is written by the winnersss, for that isss the sssymbol of the Great Lord Xeric.
Or at leassst, that isss what the lizardmen tell me...

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-with-the-fisher.player: Are you the 'Rey' this entry mentions?

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-with-the-fisher.npc: Oh, that wasss a lifetime ago... Sssuch a wonderful little one.

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-with-the-fisher.player: So you've not seen her recently?

using-kharedst-s-memoirs-with-the-fisher.npc: Lassst I heard, her mind had cracked. Her father died and...
